the oocytes of the mouse embryo can be labeled with radioactive thymidine and autoradiographic evidence of DNA synthesis was found in the nuclei of oocytes at all stages of meiotic prophase.

the mouse embryo is able to incorporate tritiated thymidine into its DNA at a time when it contains only a small number of oocytes.
